name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: Jerry-Lees
---

## Feature Request

### Summary
<!-- One clear sentence describing the feature you'd like to see -->


### The Problem
<!-- What problem does this feature solve? What are you trying to do that you can't do today? -->


### Proposed Solution
<!-- Describe how you'd like it to work. Be as specific or as general as you like. -->


### Alternatives Considered
<!-- Have you found any workarounds or alternative approaches? -->


### Use Case
<!-- Who benefits from this feature and how? The more context the better. -->


### Additional Context
<!-- Any screenshots, diagrams, links, or examples that help explain the request -->


### Priority
<!-- How important is this to your workflow? -->
- [ ] Critical — blocking my use of the tool
- [ ] High — would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium — nice to have
- [ ] Low — minor improvement or polish

---
*Feature requests are welcome and carefully considered. Not every request will be implemented,
but all are read and appreciated. If you'd like to implement this yourself, say so below —
pull requests are always welcome.*
